about.description: Index or fund perpetual futures market on QFEX tracking ProShares Ultra VIX Short-Term Futures ETF, quoted in USD, cross-margined in USDC and trading 24/7 with up to 30x leverage. QFEX is a hybrid central-limit-order-book exchange for traditional assets only; positions are cash-settled and confer no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Reference prices are consumed from primary venues during the instrument's published reference-price hours and funding is zero outside them. Added 2026-10-02 from QFEX's own /refdata API, which reported 213 ACTIVE markets against the 190 already carried here.
